_readme: Plain explanations of request fields and parameters, shared by every endpoint of docs/html/API.html. An endpoint can override one with "fields" or "paramHelp" in api.json. tools/build-api-docs.mjs fails when a field or parameter has no explanation.

fields.adMode: How ads reach viewers on this destination: SSAI = stitched into the stream by us, SGAI = the player inserts them, PASSTHROUGH = only markers, the destination sells its own ads.
fields.adSecondsPerHour: Most ad time per hour on this channel, in seconds (e.g. 360 = 6 minutes).
fields.adsAllowed: Whether ads may run during this video.
fields.advertiser: Who pays for the campaign, as shown in reports.
fields.allChannels: true = share every channel, including ones created later. false = only the channels in channelIds.
fields.allowedCountries: 2-letter country codes where the video may play (WW = worldwide). Empty = rights incomplete, so it plays nowhere.
fields.assetId: ID of a video from the library (List videos).
fields.assetIds: IDs of videos to use. Leave out to use every ready video.
fields.at: Moment to check (ISO date-time). Default: now.
fields.audiences: Signed audience keys the campaign targets (from your viewer app's context). Empty = everyone.
fields.autofillHours: Fill this many hours of schedule right away with the videos in assetIds.
fields.baseRole: The built-in role this custom role starts from; it can never do more than that role.
fields.blockedCountries: 2-letter country codes where the video must not play, even inside allowed regions.
fields.body: The email text. {{placeholders}} are filled in when it is sent.
fields.breakId: ID of the ad break (from the schedule, avails or the stream's markers).
fields.breakSeconds: Default length of an ad break on this channel, in seconds.
fields.campaignId: ID of the campaign whose ad played.
fields.category: What the connector is for: MEDIA, ADS, STORAGE or OTHER.
fields.channel: The channel's short name (slug), as in its watch address.
fields.channelIds: IDs of the channels to share (when allChannels is false).
fields.color: Colour as #RRGGBB, used in the guide and on generated samples.
fields.connectorKey: Connector this property belongs to (shown with that connector's settings). Leave out for a general property.
fields.country: 2-letter country code of the viewer (e.g. IN, GB, US).
fields.cpm: Price per 1000 impressions, used for estimated revenue and ordering.
fields.creativeAssetId: ID of the ad video (a ready asset of kind AD).
fields.cuePoints: Where ad breaks may go inside the video, in milliseconds from the start. Snapped to 5-second boundaries.
fields.currency: 3-letter currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, INR.
fields.customRoleKey: Key of a custom role (from Roles you can give) to use instead of the built-in role's permissions.
fields.days: How many days ahead to generate (1–31).
fields.defaultType: Media type new videos get by default.
fields.defaultValue: Value everyone gets unless a tenant or project sets their own.
fields.driver: Which server adapter runs the connector: MUX, VAST, R2 or CUSTOM. Can't change later.
fields.enabled: true = switched on, false = switched off.
fields.enabledTypes: Media types the project uses (must be enabled for it by the platform).
fields.endDate: Last day the rule places episodes (YYYY-MM-DD).
fields.endsAt: When the campaign stops (ISO date-time, UTC unless an offset is given).
fields.environment: Label of the Mux environment, for your reference (e.g. Production).
fields.episode: Episode number within the season (episodes only).
fields.event: What happened: IMPRESSION, FIRST_QUARTILE, MIDPOINT, THIRD_QUARTILE or COMPLETE.
fields.expectedRevision: The revision number you last read (from the matching GET). If someone saved since, you get 409/412 and should reload, so nobody overwrites anyone.
fields.expiresAt: When access ends by itself (ISO date-time). Leave out for no end.
fields.expiresInDays: Days until the token stops working (1–3650). Leave out for no expiry.
fields.fallbackAssetId: Video that plays when nothing is scheduled.
fields.frequencyCap: How many times one viewer may see this campaign per day (0 = no cap).
fields.genre: Genre shown in the guide, e.g. Documentary.
fields.hours: How many hours ahead to fill.
fields.ids: IDs in the order you want.
fields.key: Stable identifier, lower-case with dashes (it can't change later).
fields.kind: Type of the item; see the allowed values.
fields.label: Name shown on screens.
fields.loop: true = start again from the first episode after the last one.
fields.markerFormat: How ad breaks are marked in the stream: DATERANGE (HLS EXT-X-DATERANGE) or CUE_OUT (EXT-X-CUE-OUT/IN).
fields.maxAdSecondsPerHour: Most ad seconds per hour this destination accepts.
fields.maxChannels: Channels a tenant on this plan may have across all its projects.
fields.maxProjects: Projects a tenant on this plan may have.
fields.mediaType: Media type key (e.g. MOVIE, EPISODE or a custom type enabled for the project).
fields.minutes: How long from 'at' to check, in minutes. Default: the video's length.
fields.monthlyPrice: Price per month in the plan's currency (for records; no payment is collected).
fields.name: Name shown on screens.
fields.note: Short note kept with the change, e.g. what this version is.
fields.options: Allowed values for a SELECT property (empty for other types).
fields.org: Organization: its short name (slug, e.g. aurora) or ID.
fields.ownerEmail: Email of the first owner; they get a welcome email with a temporary password.
fields.ownerName: Full name of the first owner.
fields.ownerUserId: ID of an existing owner or admin of the tenant who will own the new project (from Possible project owners).
fields.partnerOrgId: ID of the partner organization (from Partner directory).
fields.passthroughTag: Only library videos with exactly this Mux passthrough value are imported. Blank = all videos.
fields.permissions: Permissions the custom role grants (within its base role).
fields.personalizedAds: Whether viewers may get personalized ads (only with their signed consent).
fields.planKey: Key of the subscription plan (List plans).
fields.premiereTime: Time of day for new episodes, HH:MM in the channel's time zone, on a 5-second boundary.
fields.prepare: true = also convert the returned ad videos now, so they can air in the next break.
fields.priority: 1–10; higher wins when several campaigns fit the same break.
fields.projectOverride: Whether projects may set their own value.
fields.refresh_token: The refresh token from Sign in (get a token). Browsers send it as a cookie instead.
fields.repeatTime: Optional second airing time for the same episode, HH:MM.
fields.replace: true = clear the draft first; false = add after what is there.
fields.reset: true = remove the value set here and inherit again (send instead of value/enabled).
fields.resolution: What was done to fix it.
fields.role: Role: OWNER, ADMIN, CONTENT_MANAGER, CHANNEL_OPERATOR, AD_OPS, ANALYST (partners: PARTNER_ADMIN, PARTNER_VIEWER; platform tokens: PLATFORM_ADMIN). Never higher than your own.
fields.sampleSeconds: Demo only: generate a fictional sample video of this many seconds (15–1800) instead of uploading.
fields.sampleTagline: Demo only: text shown on a generated sample ad.
fields.scopes: What may be read, e.g. channels:read, epg:read, stream:read, breaks:read, delivery:read.
fields.secret: true = value stored encrypted and never shown again.
fields.series: Series name; episodes of one series are numbered by season and episode.
fields.slug: Short name used in addresses: 3–40 lower-case letters, digits or dashes. Can't be changed later.
fields.startAt: Start time (ISO date-time). Leave out to add after the last entry. Snapped to 5 seconds.
fields.startDate: First day the rule places episodes (YYYY-MM-DD).
fields.status: New status; see the allowed values.
fields.subject: Email subject. {{placeholders}} are filled in when it is sent.
fields.tagUrl: Public https address of the VAST ad tag. Stored encrypted; leave out when editing to keep it.
fields.territories: 2-letter country codes where this is offered or runs.
fields.timeoutMs: How long to wait for the ad server, in milliseconds (100–5000).
fields.timezone: IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Kolkata, Europe/London.
fields.title: Title shown in the library and the guide.
fields.to: Address to send the test email to.
fields.token: The one-time code from the reset email link.
fields.tokenId: Mux access token ID. Blank keeps the stored one.
fields.tokenSecret: Mux access token secret. Blank keeps the stored one. Never returned.
fields.types: Media type keys the project may use.
fields.validFrom: Start of the licence (ISO date-time). Leave out for 'already valid'.
fields.validUntil: End of the licence (ISO date-time). Leave out for no end.
fields.value: The value, as JSON: "text" in quotes, numbers and true/false without.
fields.valueType: STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN or SELECT (one of options).
fields.versionNumber: Published version number to bring back.
fields.viewerToken: Signed viewer context from your app's server (for personalized ads). Leave out for contextual ads only.
fields.webhookSecret: Mux webhook signing secret, to verify deliveries. Blank keeps the stored one.
fields.withBreaks: true = also insert ad breaks at the video's cue points.

params.org: The project: its short name (e.g. aurora) or ID. You must be a member and your token must be for it.
params.tenant: ID (UUID) of the customer tenant (List tenants).
params.project: ID (UUID) of a project of that tenant.
params.partner: The partner organization: short name (e.g. partner-tv) or ID.
params.owner: The customer sharing with you: short name or ID.
params.userId: ID of the person (from List members).
params.entryId: ID of the schedule entry (from Read the schedule).
params.ruleId: ID of the programming rule (from List rules).
params.session: ID of the viewing session (from Start a viewing session).
params.id: ID of the item (see the endpoint).
params.key: Key of the item (see the endpoint).
params.q: Text to search in title, genre and series.
params.kind: Only this kind: MOVIE, EPISODE, SHORT or AD.
params.from: Start of the window (ISO date-time). Default: now.
params.hours: Length of the window in hours.
params.wholeProgramme: true = also remove the programme's ad breaks and other parts.
params.client_id: API client ID (or send it with HTTP Basic).
params.client_secret: API client secret (or send it with HTTP Basic).
params.scope: Space-separated scopes to ask for; default: everything the client may read.
params.file: The video file, sent as a multipart form field named file.
